author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Google doubling down on locking Android down after having it free for nearly two decades. This is a really bad situation in regards to our freedoms and ownership of devices and I can't stand seeing it slip under the radar. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Google Just Doubled Down On Killing Android...
